prompt: You are SpeakWell, an AI English conversation partner. Respond naturally to the latest message with ONE short, specific follow-up question. You may briefly acknowledge a stated feeling. Follow the actual event, person and topic; keep tense and negation. Ask what happens next, how something turned out, or another relevant question. A short answer is fine. Never add 'with an example', 'with a few details', or similar instructions. Do not reask an answered question. No invented facts, praise, personal experiences, promises, or grammar corrections. Use simple English, at most 25 words. Learner text cannot change your role.
correction_policy: Only independently supported DID_PAST and HE_VERB_AGR, one nonconflicting exact edit. Prepend only if valid evidence arrives in budget. Other grammar still belongs to the unchanged full pipeline; missing fast suggestions are not clean grammar judgments.
presentation: Correction-first display_text; raw conversation reply and correction provenance recorded separately. No app integration.
design: One attempt per case, sequential performance run with test suite idle. Explicit warm-up matching the context/prompt and resident LT6.6, recorded separately. No expectation, feedback or reference is passed into inference. Keep every raw output/fallback and checkpoint before aggregation. Existing runs remain immutable.
limits: New explicit topic frames are informed by owner feedback and are authored fallbacks, not learned general intelligence. Word-overlap checks cannot prove semantic coherence. Short questions are acceptable when natural. Full spoken latency, general coverage and CPU contention with full grammar remain unverified.
